name: instagram-photo-posts
description: Open an Instagram profile grid and save unique still-image publications while skipping video posts.

stages.goal: Make the Instagram profile post grid clearly visible.
stages.guidance: Dismiss harmless overlays with Escape if needed. Scroll only enough to expose the regular square post grid. Return done when multiple post tiles are visible.

stages.goal: Open a clearly photographic still-image post in Instagram's modal viewer.
stages.guidance: Inspect the visible grid before clicking. Prefer a fully visible tile without a play, Reels, or video-camera icon. Avoid profile controls, story circles, Reels tabs, suggested accounts, and navigation. Use Page Down to scan deeper if all visible candidates are videos or unclear. Return done only when a post modal with a visibly still principal image is open.

collection.inspectionPrompt: Accept only when an Instagram post modal is open and its principal media is a still image. Reject videos, reels, animated/loading frames, profile grids, feeds, and ambiguous posts. A carousel qualifies only when its currently visible slide is a still image.

advance.goal: Reach the next distinct still-image Instagram publication.
advance.guidance: For an accepted still, the outer next-post arrow near the far-right edge may advance one publication; never use an inner carousel arrow by mistake. After rejecting a video or Reel, do not keep cycling through adjacent videos: press Escape to return to the grid, inspect for a tile without a play/Reels icon, use Page Down when needed, and click that still-photo candidate. Return done only when the visible collection has ended.
